newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's Elbit in talks to sell unit.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Elbit in talks to sell unit.

text.p: Israel's Elbit Ltd has started negotiations for the sale of its Boston subsidiary Inframetrics Inc to a consortium set up by U.S. Advent International Corp and Inframetrics's management for $30 million, Elbit said.
In a statement to the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange, Elbit said it had started negotiations for the sale of 80 percent of its fully owned Boston subsidiary.
Elbit said it expected to get $30 million in cash and in credit from the sale.
The investors will have the option of buying the remaining shares from Elbit, the statement said.
Elbit said it expected the sale to add to its profits but could not yet estimate a figure since the deal had not been finalised.
The deal is subject to additional controls and permits.
Elbit, also traded on Nasdaq develops, manufactures and services a wide range of electronic systems and products for medical, defence and commercial applications.
It is a subsidiary of Elron Electronic Industries Ltd.
Inframetrics Inc produces infra-red imaging radiometres for the detection of heat in medical, industry and military applications. - Tel Aviv newsroom, 972-3-537-2211
